description:
"Logged today" is a flat newest-first list collapsed to three rows (FuelPanel.tsx COLLAPSED_ENTRIES), so a full day reads as "+9 more".

- Group entries into Morning / Midday / Afternoon / Evening, derived from loggedAt in the user's local zone. No meal column and no schema change. The boundaries (proposed: before 11:00, 11–15, 15–18, 18 onward) live in one pure function in apps/web/src/lib/fuel.ts, tested beside it (fuel.test.ts). A calendar boundary belongs to the user (RULES 6).
- Each group header shows its subtotal (protein · kcal). An empty group that is still ahead today reads "Nothing yet"; past empty groups are omitted.
- Tapping a row opens it (the T-046 edit) with three 44px actions: Edit, Log again (same food and portion, now), Remove. Remove uses the armed confirm (useArmedConfirm), which closes ISS-016.
- Drop the three-row collapse on the Fuel page: the page is the place for the whole day. The Start summary card shows no log.

Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/CD3dbZS6upyEbpCcv25c2g (Main, lower half).
title: Group the day's fuel log by part of day, with per-row actions
